[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant explains the Pomodoro Technique, detailing the steps: choose a task, set a timer for 25 minutes, work without interruptions, take a 5-minute break, repeat, and take a longer break after four rounds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant lists benefits of Pomodoro Timers for writing: eliminate distractions, create urgency, build momentum, improve time estimation, and reduce burnout.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provides examples of digital Pomodoro Timers: Tomato Timer, Pomofocus, Focus Booster, Forest, and mobile apps.
